description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Ice with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Retainer Mode I (Firion)] and [(Samurai/Knight) Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Retainer Mode I (Firion)
description.text: Samurai and Knight abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Samurai and Knight abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for Samurai and Knight abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Retainer Mode II (Firion)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Retainer Mode II (Firion)
description.text: Samurai and Knight abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Samurai and Knight abilities, casts Dual Frost Sword after using Samurai and Knight abilities

description.name: Dual Frost Sword
description.text: One single attack (2.64) capped at 99999, 100% hit rate, grants [100% Critical 3] and [Deadly Strikes +20% 3] to the user

description.name: Deadly Strikes +20% 3
description.text: Critical hits deal 20% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient and other Critical Damage statuses)

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: (Samurai/Knight) Resonance +5% Boost
